tradeoff_note: Set by the user (2026-10-23): 20 damage every half second. A progression barrier, not a combat hazard: double suffocation's drain on purpose so the pool can't be swum before the diving item (which will grant buffImmune). Like Calamity's Sulphurous Sea the biome turns ALL its water into tar, so the yard's 2-3-tile puddles burn too: a quick dip costs 40-80 life (D5 sim: 4 ticks, 80), wading an 8-tile puddle about 160 (lethal at 100 max life). Puddles are jumpable. Options if too punishing: harmless puddles (pool only), fewer/shallower puddles, or a weaker tick outside the pool.
